note: D-75 (0.1.6; owner 2026-11-08: tell the plugin's idle compaction from Claude Code's own by separate terms; the owner read idle_handoff_min_tokens 100000 as the idle-compaction minimum): the status `idle compaction:` line names native idle compaction (Claude Code) and plugin idle compaction apart and prints each path's token band from the effective values: the idle-compaction minimum as the mod's idle_mode row has it, else CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS as native reads it (200,000 by default, never below 100,000); the idle handoff turn from idle_handoff_min_tokens (clamped to 100,000 to 1,000,000) up to that minimum, or up from it when the plugin does not compact; no turn band when idle_handoff_min_tokens is not below the minimum.
